name_resolution.rationale: Kew POWO explicitly treats the book name Betula verrucosa as a synonym of Betula pendula subsp. pendula. Taiwan Ministry of Agriculture import-quarantine material pairs Betula pendula with 歐洲白樺; Taiwan Forestry Research Institute and National Taiwan Science Education Center materials independently pair Betula pendula with 垂枝樺. No Taiwan occurrence is inferred from import or research references.

warnings: TaiCOL and Tai2 do not provide an exact species record; the scientific synonym bridge comes from Kew POWO.
The Taiwan sources cite Betula pendula at species rank, while POWO resolves Betula verrucosa to Betula pendula subsp. pendula.
Import-quarantine and research references do not establish Taiwan occurrence.
Köhler book facts are separate from external Taiwan naming metadata.
Historical uses are not modern medical advice.
Plate and image claims are excluded until visual review.
